mainEntity.name: How do I book a minicab from Plaistow E13 to Heathrow Airport?

mainEntity.name: How far is Plaistow E13 from Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plaistow E13 is approximately 16 miles (26 km) from Heathrow Airport via the A13 westbound connecting to the A406 North Circular and then the A40 towards Heathrow. Journey times typically range from 40 to 65 minutes depending on traffic conditions along the A13 corridor and the A40 westbound approach.
